**Supplementary Table S6.** Model-proposed medication mapping (mapping d) against the reviewer, first audit round. The model (gpt-oss-120b, run in the author's own cloud account with invocation logging off) answered the same question as the reviewer for each worklist entry, choosing only among RxNorm candidates, without seeing the reviewer's decisions. "Same decision for the measures": both excluded the entry, or both included it with the same CMS816 and CMS871 value-set membership (for mixtures, the same keep or drop). Counts are of medication codes, not patients.

| Entry type | Entries | Reviewer included | Model also included | Model left out | Model added | Same decision for the measures (%) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Excluded codes, high volume (audit round 1) | 671 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 9 | 662 (98.7) |
| Excluded codes, random low-volume sample (audit round 1) | 300 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 299 (99.7) |
| Product code (NDC) not mapped | 103 | 83 | 52 | 31 | 20 | 45 (43.7) |
| No product code | 282 | 196 | 193 | 3 | 84 | 177 (62.8) |
| Mixture containing a value-set drug | 54 | 30 | 30 | 0 | 24 | 30 (55.6) |
| ICU infusion item | 8 | 8 | 8 | 0 | 0 | 7 (87.5) |
| **All entries** | 1,418 | 317 | 283 | 34 | 138 | 1,220 (86.0) |

Excluded codes (first two rows): same decision for 961 of 971 (99.0%). Entries needing judgment (the other four rows): 259 of 447 (57.9%).

| By the model's stated confidence | Entries | Same decision for the measures (%) |
|---|---:|---:|
| High | 1,231 | 1,130 (91.8) |
| Medium | 165 | 85 (51.5) |
| Low | 22 | 5 (22.7) |

Run: 1,418 entries, 1,418 answered, 0 unparsed, 0 errors, 0 proposed codes rejected by the RxNorm check; 12.5 minutes with four parallel requests; 900,693 input and 185,317 output tokens; estimated cost US$0.25.

Review by exception: accepting every high-confidence answer without review would have left 187 of 1,418 entries for a person, but kept 101 answers that change a measure, covering at least 36,679 administrations (codes with 10 or more administrations only).
